projects.title: FinFlash
projects.tagline: Live SEC filings and corporate events, extracted into Excel-ready data in minutes.
projects.problem: Investment analysts need SEC filing data fast. Reading a 10-K or 8-K by hand and rebuilding the numbers in Excel takes too long when a market-moving filing just dropped.
projects.solution: Built a live market intelligence dashboard that tracks 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K filings from major companies as they're filed. Each filing can be viewed instantly or extracted into structured, Excel-ready financials with one click. The backend runs on Supabase edge functions that fetch and parse filings, with a Postgres cache layer and a dedicated storage bucket for the source documents.
impact: Tracks live 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K filings from companies like Netflix, Oracle, Salesforce, Nvidia, and Apple
One-click extraction into structured, Excel-ready data
Supabase-backed caching layer with service-role-only write access

projects.title: Brand Size Matcher
projects.tagline: Know your size in one brand? Find your match across 18 others.
projects.problem: Clothing sizes are a mess. A Medium in Zara fits nothing like a Medium in H&M. Every online purchase is a gamble, and returns are a pain.
projects.solution: Built a tool that uses IoU-based measurement matching to translate your known size in one brand to equivalent sizes across 18 brands — international and Indian D2C labels included.

projects.title: Padagemi (పదగేమి)
projects.tagline: A 2-minute Telugu crossword — guess 4 words from 12 clues.
projects.problem: Wanted a quick, casual word game for Telugu speakers — something in the language itself, not just another English crossword.
projects.solution: Built a mini Telugu crossword game in React: small 4-word grids, 12 clues, answers accepted in English, Tinglish, or Telugu script so there's no mental friction switching keyboards. Puzzle data is served from a Supabase Edge Function.
impact: Answers accepted in 3 input styles: English, Tinglish, Telugu
Deployed on Vercel, backend on Supabase
